en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

zhSimplified.text: 「你吩咐以色列人，使一切长大麻风的，患漏症的，并因死尸不洁净的，都出营外去。

zhTraditional.text: 「你吩咐以色列人，使一切長大痲瘋的，患漏症的，並因死屍不潔淨的，都出營外去。

en.text: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

zhSimplified.text: 无论男女都要使他们出到营外，免得污秽他们的营；这营是我所住的。」

zhTraditional.text: 無論男女都要使他們出到營外，免得污穢他們的營；這營是我所住的。」

en.text: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人就这样行，使他们出到营外。耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样行了。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人就這樣行，使他們出到營外。耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣行了。

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：无论男女，若犯了人所常犯的罪，以致干犯耶和华，那人就有了罪。

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女，若犯了人所常犯的罪，以致干犯耶和華，那人就有了罪。

en.text: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

zhSimplified.text: 他要承认所犯的罪，将所亏负人的，如数赔还，另外加上五分之一，也归与所亏负的人。

zhTraditional.text: 他要承認所犯的罪，將所虧負人的，如數賠還，另外加上五分之一，也歸與所虧負的人。

en.text: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

zhSimplified.text: 那人若没有亲属可受所赔还的，那所赔还的就要归与服事耶和华的祭司；至于那为他赎罪的公羊是在外。

zhTraditional.text: 那人若沒有親屬可受所賠還的，那所賠還的就要歸與服事耶和華的祭司；至於那為他贖罪的公羊是在外。

en.text: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人一切的圣物中，所奉给祭司的举祭都要归与祭司。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人一切的聖物中，所奉給祭司的舉祭都要歸與祭司。

en.text: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

zhSimplified.text: 各人所分别为圣的物，无论是什么，都要归给祭司。」

zhTraditional.text: 各人所分別為聖的物，無論是甚麼，都要歸給祭司。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：人的妻若有邪行，得罪她丈夫，

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：人的妻若有邪行，得罪她丈夫，

en.text: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

zhSimplified.text: 有人与她行淫，事情严密，瞒过她丈夫，而且她被玷污，没有作见证的人，当她行淫的时候也没有被捉住，

zhTraditional.text: 有人與她行淫，事情嚴密，瞞過她丈夫，而且她被玷污，沒有作見證的人，當她行淫的時候也沒有被捉住，

en.text: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

zhSimplified.text: 她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她是被玷污，或是她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她并没有被玷污，

zhTraditional.text: 她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她是被玷污，或是她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她並沒有被玷污，

en.text: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

footnotes.text: 5:15 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 这人就要将妻送到祭司那里，又为她带着大麦面伊法十分之一作供物，不可浇上油，也不可加上乳香；因为这是疑恨的素祭，是思念的素祭，使人思念罪孽。

zhTraditional.text: 這人就要將妻送到祭司那裏，又為她帶着大麥麵伊法十分之一作供物，不可澆上油，也不可加上乳香；因為這是疑恨的素祭，是思念的素祭，使人思念罪孽。

en.text: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 「祭司要使那妇人近前来，站在耶和华面前。

zhTraditional.text: 「祭司要使那婦人近前來，站在耶和華面前。

en.text: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要把圣水盛在瓦器里，又从帐幕的地上取点尘土，放在水中。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要把聖水盛在瓦器裏，又從帳幕的地上取點塵土，放在水中。

en.text: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要叫那妇人蓬头散发，站在耶和华面前，把思念的素祭，就是疑恨的素祭，放在她手中。祭司手里拿着致咒诅的苦水，

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要叫那婦人蓬頭散髮，站在耶和華面前，把思念的素祭，就是疑恨的素祭，放在她手中。祭司手裏拿着致咒詛的苦水，

en.text: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

zhSimplified.text: 要叫妇人起誓，对她说：『若没有人与你行淫，也未曾背着丈夫做污秽的事，你就免受这致咒诅苦水的灾。

zhTraditional.text: 要叫婦人起誓，對她說：『若沒有人與你行淫，也未曾背着丈夫做污穢的事，你就免受這致咒詛苦水的災。

en.text: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

zhSimplified.text: 你若背着丈夫行了污秽的事，在你丈夫以外有人与你行淫，

zhTraditional.text: 你若背着丈夫行了污穢的事，在你丈夫以外有人與你行淫，

en.text: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

zhSimplified.text: （祭司叫妇人发咒起誓，）愿耶和华叫你大腿消瘦，肚腹发胀，使你在你民中被人咒诅，成了誓语；

zhTraditional.text: （祭司叫婦人發咒起誓），願耶和華叫你大腿消瘦，肚腹發脹，使你在你民中被人咒詛，成了誓語；

en.text: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

zhSimplified.text: 并且这致咒诅的水入你的肠中，要叫你的肚腹发胀，大腿消瘦。』妇人要回答说：『阿们，阿们。』

zhTraditional.text: 並且這致咒詛的水入你的腸中，要叫你的肚腹發脹，大腿消瘦。』婦人要回答說：『阿們，阿們。』

en.text: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

zhSimplified.text: 「祭司要写这咒诅的话，将所写的字抹在苦水里，

zhTraditional.text: 「祭司要寫這咒詛的話，將所寫的字抹在苦水裏，

en.text: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

zhSimplified.text: 又叫妇人喝这致咒诅的苦水；这水要进入她里面变苦了。

zhTraditional.text: 又叫婦人喝這致咒詛的苦水；這水要進入她裏面變苦了。

en.text: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要从妇人的手中取那疑恨的素祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，拿到坛前；

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要從婦人的手中取那疑恨的素祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，拿到壇前；

en.text: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

zhSimplified.text: 又要从素祭中取出一把，作为这事的纪念，烧在坛上，然后叫妇人喝这水。

zhTraditional.text: 又要從素祭中取出一把，作為這事的紀念，燒在壇上，然後叫婦人喝這水。

en.text: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

zhSimplified.text: 叫她喝了以后，她若被玷污，得罪了丈夫，这致咒诅的水必进入她里面变苦了，她的肚腹就要发胀，大腿就要消瘦，那妇人便要在他民中被人咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 叫她喝了以後，她若被玷污，得罪了丈夫，這致咒詛的水必進入她裏面變苦了，她的肚腹就要發脹，大腿就要消瘦，那婦人便要在他民中被人咒詛。

en.text: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

zhSimplified.text: 若妇人没有被玷污，却是清洁的，就要免受这灾，且要怀孕。

zhTraditional.text: 若婦人沒有被玷污，卻是清潔的，就要免受這災，且要懷孕。

en.text: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

zhSimplified.text: 「妻子背着丈夫行了污秽的事，

zhTraditional.text: 「妻子背着丈夫行了污穢的事，

en.text: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

zhSimplified.text: 或是人生了疑恨的心，疑恨他的妻，就有这疑恨的条例。那时他要叫妇人站在耶和华面前，祭司要在她身上照这条例而行。

zhTraditional.text: 或是人生了疑恨的心，疑恨他的妻，就有這疑恨的條例。那時他要叫婦人站在耶和華面前，祭司要在她身上照這條例而行。

en.text: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

zhSimplified.text: 男人就为无罪，妇人必担当自己的罪孽。」

zhTraditional.text: 男人就為無罪，婦人必擔當自己的罪孽。」
